name: Unnamed Project

entity_types.name: GovernmentOfficial
entity_types.description: High-ranking state leaders and ministers who shape foreign policy and public discourse.

attributes.name: official_title
attributes.description: The specific rank or position held by the official.

attributes.name: country_affiliation
attributes.description: The nation the official represents (e.g., Thailand or Cambodia).

attributes.name: political_party
attributes.description: The political faction the official belongs to.

entity_types.name: Diplomat
entity_types.description: Representatives of the foreign ministry involved in international negotiations and embassies.

attributes.name: diplomatic_rank
attributes.description: The rank of the diplomat, such as Ambassador or Consul.

attributes.name: assigned_country
attributes.description: The country where the diplomat is currently stationed.

entity_types.name: MilitaryUnit
entity_types.description: Armed forces accounts or units, particularly those stationed near border regions.

attributes.name: unit_designation
attributes.description: The specific name or number of the military unit.

attributes.name: command_region
attributes.description: The geographical area under the unit's responsibility.

entity_types.name: MediaOutlet
entity_types.description: News organizations and digital platforms that report on geopolitical events.

attributes.name: media_type
attributes.description: The format of the media, such as TV, Newspaper, or Digital News.

attributes.name: editorial_bias
attributes.description: The perceived political or national leaning of the outlet.

entity_types.name: PoliticalActivist
entity_types.description: Individuals or group leaders who advocate for nationalistic or specific political causes.

attributes.name: cause_focus
attributes.description: The primary issue the activist campaigns for (e.g., border sovereignty).

attributes.name: movement_affiliation
attributes.description: The name of the political movement or group they lead.

entity_types.name: InternationalOrganization
entity_types.description: Supranational bodies that monitor or mediate regional conflicts.

attributes.name: org_scope
attributes.description: The reach of the organization (e.g., Regional, Global).

attributes.name: mandate_description
attributes.description: The primary goal of the organization in the region.

entity_types.name: BusinessAssociation
entity_types.description: Groups representing trade interests that may be affected by border frictions.

attributes.name: industry_sector
attributes.description: The primary industry represented (e.g., Tourism, Agriculture).

attributes.name: trade_volume_focus
attributes.description: The scale of cross-border trade interests.

entity_types.name: Journalist
entity_types.description: Individual reporters or correspondents who post updates and opinions on social media.

attributes.name: beat_coverage
attributes.description: The specific topic the journalist covers (e.g., Geopolitics, Defense).

attributes.name: professional_bio
attributes.description: Brief professional background of the journalist.

entity_types.name: Person
entity_types.description: Fallback type for any natural person, such as netizens, citizens, or local residents.

attributes.name: citizenship
attributes.description: The nationality of the individual.

attributes.name: social_bio
attributes.description: The user's self-description on social media.

entity_types.name: Organization
entity_types.description: Fallback type for any group or entity not covered by specific categories.

attributes.name: primary_mission
attributes.description: The main purpose or goal of the organization.

attributes.name: location_hq
attributes.description: The headquarters location of the organization.

edge_types.name: CRITICIZES
edge_types.description: Expresses disapproval or negative opinion regarding another entity's actions.

edge_types.name: NEGOTIATES_WITH
edge_types.description: Engages in formal or informal discussions to resolve frictions.

edge_types.name: REPORTS_ON
edge_types.description: Provides news coverage or updates about an entity or event.

edge_types.name: PROTESTS_AGAINST
edge_types.description: Publicly demonstrates opposition to an entity's policies or presence.

edge_types.name: MEDIATES_BETWEEN
edge_types.description: Acts as an intermediary to facilitate communication between two parties.

edge_types.name: ADVOCATES_FOR
edge_types.description: Publicly supports a specific policy or the interests of another entity.

edge_types.name: MONITORS_BORDER
edge_types.description: Observes and manages activities along the national boundary.

edge_types.name: POSTS_OPINION
edge_types.description: Shares a personal or professional viewpoint on a social platform.

analysis_summary: The ontology is designed to simulate the complex geopolitical relationship between Thailand and Cambodia in 2016. It focuses on state actors (officials, diplomats, military), influencers (activists, journalists), and economic stakeholders (business associations) who drive social media narratives during periods of friction. Fallback types ensure all social media participants are captured.
simulation_requirement: predict thai vs cambodia relationship in 2016
